entries.title: Lockfile integrity mismatch
entries.root_cause: The locked integrity hash for the npm package picomatch does not match the downloaded package. Refresh the incorrect lockfile entry against the trusted registry.

entries.title: Chart label type mismatch
entries.root_cause: The chart renderer passes a numeric label to formatLabel, which requires a string. Convert the label or correct its type before calling the formatter.

entries.title: Chart limit type mismatch
entries.root_cause: The chart renderer passes a string limit to clampLimit, which requires a number. Parse and validate the limit before calling the helper.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e2, deno check reports TS2345 in the chart renderer, but this concerns a separate argument and helper requiring a different fix.

entries.title: Chart label type mismatch
entries.root_cause: The chart renderer passes a numeric label to formatLabel, which requires a string. Convert the label or correct its type before calling the formatter.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The later run checks another entry point, includes unrelated changes and reports a shifted source line; the same numeric label still reaches formatLabel.
